notes.subject: הרבות
notes.rationale: KJV reads 'when your gardens increased' (verb); ASV/JPS read 'the multitude of your gardens' (noun) — mi holim pasin noun.

notes.subject: הגזם
notes.rationale: גזם em i nem bilong wanpela kain grasstok; mi raitim nois bilong Hibru 'gazam'.

notes.subject: em olgeta
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat objekt long יאכל; mi putim ⟨em⟩ bilong klia.

notes.subject: long Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tok stret long ol man Yisrael.

translation: Mi paitim ⟨את⟩ yupela wantaim shidafon (sik nogut bilong diwai) na wantaim yerakon (kol karim long diwai); planti ol ga den bilong yupela, na ol gaden wain bilong yupela, na ol fig diwai bilong yupela, na ol oliv diwai bilong yupela — gazam i kaikai ⟨em⟩ olgeta; tasol yupela i no kirap i kam bek long mi, Yahwe i tok.

na ol fig diwai bilong yupela
